title: (RHBA-2023:5397) Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation 4.10.15 Bug Fix Update
portal_summary:
Updated images that fix several bugs are now available for Red Hat
OpenShift Data Foundation 4.10.15 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 from Red
Hat Container Registry.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation 4.10.15 Bug Fix Update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation for IBM Power, little endian|4|ppc64le
Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|4|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation for IBM Z and LinuxONE|4|s390x
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation is software-defined storage integrated with and optimized for the Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation. Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation is a highly scalable, production-grade persistent storage for stateful applications running in the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform. In addition to persistent storage, Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation provisions a multi-cloud data management service with an S3-compatible API.

Enhancement:

* With this release, an ability to disable reconcile for MONs and OSDs is provided. This ability allows the support team to skip reconcile of MONs and OSDs by adding the `do-not-reconcile` label to their deployments and make custom modifications to Ceph daemons without stopping the operator. (BZ#2233674)

All users of Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation are advised to upgrade to these updated images, which provide these bug fixes.
